metadata.target_conclusion: The Germanwings flight disappeared from the radar at 9.39 UTC

posts.text: Flight 9525 last seen over Europe at 9:39 UTC. No further contact. #Germanwings #FlightDisappearance
Pilots reported unusual readings on navigation systems just before losing contact. #SuspicionGrows
Experts warn of potential software glitches affecting flight systems. #TechnicalConcerns
Temporary system failures can lead to loss of communication. #FlightSafety
Initial investigation suggests possible software glitch. Could this explain the disappearance? #Theory
Official report confirms technical malfunction as primary cause. #Conclusion
